Highcharts 树状图(Treemap)

本章节我们将为大家介绍 Highcharts 的热点图。

我们在前面的章节已经了解了 Highcharts 配置语法。接下来让我们来看下 Highcharts 的其他配置。

树状图

series 配置

设置 series 的 type 属性为 treemap ，series.type 描述了数据列类型。默认值为 "line"。 

var chart = {
   type: 'treemap'
};

实例

大数据量树状图

以下实例颜色了大数据量的树状图，具体实例数据可通过点击"尝试一下"查看。

文件名：highcharts_tree_largemap.htm



 charset="UTF-8" />
</span><span style="color: rgb(43, 43, 43); background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); font-size: 13px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-weight: 400; line-height: 20.8px; border: 0px none rgb(43, 43, 43); border-bottom: 0px none rgb(43, 43, 43); border-left: 0px none rgb(43, 43, 43); border-right: 0px none rgb(43, 43, 43); border-top: 0px none rgb(43, 43, 43); text-align: start; word-break: break-word; vertical-align: baseline; display: inline; position: static; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) none repeat scroll 0% 0% / auto padding-box border-box; background-position: 0% 0%; background-repeat: repeat; list-style: outside none disc; transition: all; opacity: 1; box-sizing: content-box; white-space: pre-wrap" class="pln">Highcharts 教程 | 菜鸟教程(runoob.com)</span><span style="color: rgb(95, 127, 79); background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); font-size: 13px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-weight: 400; line-height: 20.8px; border: 0px none rgb(95, 127, 79); border-bottom: 0px none rgb(95, 127, 79); border-left: 0px none rgb(95, 127, 79); border-right: 0px none rgb(95, 127, 79); border-top: 0px none rgb(95, 127, 79); text-align: start; word-break: break-word; vertical-align: baseline; display: inline; position: static; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) none repeat scroll 0% 0% / auto padding-box border-box; background-position: 0% 0%; background-repeat: repeat; list-style: outside none disc; transition: all; opacity: 1; box-sizing: content-box; white-space: pre-wrap" class="tag">
 src="http://apps.bdimg.com/libs/jquery/2.1.4/jquery.min.js">
 src="http://code.highcharts.com/highcharts.js">   
 src="http://code.highcharts.com/modules/treemap.js">    
 src="http://code.highcharts.com/modules/heatmap.js">  


 id="container" style="width: 550px; height: 400px; margin: 0 auto">
 language="JavaScript">
$(document).ready(function() { 
//省略部分 js 代码
 var data = {……};
 var points = [],
        region_p,
        region_val,
        region_i,
        country_p,
        country_i,
        cause_p,
        cause_i,
        cause_name = [];
    cause_name['Communicable & other Group I'] = 'Communicable diseases';
    cause_name['Noncommunicable diseases'] = 'Non-communicable diseases';
    cause_name['Injuries'] = 'Injuries';
    region_i = 0;
    for (var region in data) {
        region_val = 0;
        region_p = {
            id: "id_" + region_i,
            name: region,
            color: Highcharts.getOptions().colors[region_i]
        };
        country_i = 0;
        for (var country in data[region]) {
            country_p = {
                id: region_p.id + "_" + country_i,
                name: country,
                parent: region_p.id
            };
            points.push(country_p);
            cause_i = 0;
            for (var cause in data[region][country]) {
                cause_p = {
                    id: country_p.id + "_" + cause_i,
                    name: cause_name[cause],
                    parent: country_p.id,
                    value: Math.round(+data[region][country][cause])
                };
                region_val += cause_p.value;
                points.push(cause_p);
                cause_i++;
            }
            country_i++;
        }
        region_p.value = Math.round(region_val / country_i);
        points.push(region_p);
        region_i++;
    }
   var chart = {
      renderTo: 'container'
   };

   var title = {
      text: 'Global Mortality Rate 2012, per 100 000 population'   
   };        
   
   var subtitle: {
      text: 'Click points to drill down. Source: WHO.'
   };
   
   var series = [{
      type: "treemap",
      layoutAlgorithm: 'squarified',
      allowDrillToNode: true,
      dataLabels: {
         enabled: false
      },
      levelIsConstant: false,
      levels: [{
         level: 1,
         dataLabels: {
            enabled: true
         },
      borderWidth: 3
      }],
      data: points
   }]; 
      
   var json = {};     
   json.title = title;            
   json.series = series;       
   
   $('#container').highcharts(json);
});
